fusions.name: Ocellus Flare
fusions.desc: Flares open across a cone 3.5 tiles long, dealing 4 damage with a 50% chance to leave each enemy [Blunted] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Heliotrope Lance
fusions.desc: A flower turns to face one enemy and looses a thorn for 28 damage that always lands as a critical hit. The target is [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Watchtower Stalk
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.3 times as far. You restore 8 health.

fusions.name: Chitted Tuber
fusions.desc: Every critical hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 stacks they all spend at once and heal you for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% in all). A stack fades every 10 seconds if none is added.
